offering_description.value: Manufactures precast concrete products such as highway barriers, drainage structures and modular buildings, sold to highway contractors and government agencies. It also installs some products on site and licenses its precast designs to other manufacturers.

primary_products.value: precast concrete barriers; box culverts and drainage structures; modular precast buildings; precast concrete septic and utility structures

primary_services.value: on-site installation of precast barriers; licensing of precast designs to other manufacturers

customer_segment.value: B2B: highway and site contractors, precast licensees, private developers; B2G: state departments of transportation and other government agencies

end_markets.value: highway and road construction; commercial construction; utilities and infrastructure; government and public works

revenue_model.value: product sales: precast barriers, culverts, drainage and modular buildings sold to contractors and agencies; service fees: installation of precast barriers and products on job sites; licensing or royalties: royalties from other manufacturers producing licensed precast designs
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: casts concrete products from raw materials, sold to contractors and government agencies; service provider: installs precast barriers and products at customer job sites; brand owner: owns precast product designs and licenses them to other manufacturers for a fee
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; brand owner

geography_served.value: US national: plants in Virginia, North Carolina and other states, selling across the eastern and central United States

specialization.value: related lines: precast barriers, drainage and culverts, modular buildings and licensed precast designs share highway and construction customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to contractors and government agencies; own locations: company-owned precast manufacturing plants; partners / resellers: licensed manufacturers producing its precast designs
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: highway product specifications and state transportation department approvals, plus environmental and workplace safety rules
